verdict.line: You lose if you eat Corrosive Charge poke and get thrown by Disdain into a level 6+ execute; you win if you farm through it and reach your health-stacking power spike.

brief.thesis: Urgot has a 10-8s cooldown skillshot (Q, Corrosive Charge) for free poke and, from level 6, an E (Disdain) dash that can throw you into R (Fear Beyond Death) range for an execute — Mundo has no dash and no ranged answer, only a point-blank AoE drain (W, Burning Agony) and a reactive AD buff (E, Masochism) that only gets strong once you're already hurt. The 48.5% win rate over 167 games and Urgot's lane/solo-kill edge both reflect that early exposure; Mundo's health-stacking core eventually outscales Urgot's burst kit in extended fights, but getting to that point safely is the entire lane.

theirWindow.when: Level 6+, you're near a wall or jungle entrance
theirWindow.what: E (Disdain, 475 range, 16-14s cooldown) charges in a line and throws the first champion it hits; paired with R (100-70s cooldown, 2500 range execute) this is his kill window. Stay out of his E arc near terrain where the throw would fling you deeper into his zone.

yourWindow.what: Once your health-stacking core is online, stand in melee range and let W (Burning Agony) drain continual damage while your regen outpaces his poke; Urgot has no sustain of his own, so long fights favor you.

start.why: Reduces the poke damage from his autos and Q (Corrosive Charge) that otherwise chips you down before you can stack health; the 45.4% win rate over 152 games and 68.5% pick rate confirm it's the standard answer to this specific harass pattern.

boots.why: 51.7% win rate over 118 games and 58.7% pick rate; the extra movement speed helps you break line of sight on Q and stay just outside E (Disdain, 475 range) once he hits 6.

core.why: Highest-winning path (57.1% over 28 games); raw max-health scales both your Adrenaline Rush regen and the damage his execute threshold (R) needs to clear.
Second item in the 57.1% win rate line; converts stacked health into stickier damage for the extended fights you want to force.
Completes the 19.9%-picked, 57.1%-winning core; gives you wave-clear and bonus damage scaled off the same health stat you're already building.

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustains you through his poke phase and scales directly with the max-health build you're already running toward, matching the 49.8%-pick, 46.4%-win rune page.

summoners.why: The 48% win rate, 55.7%-picked combo; Teleport lets you reset for potions without losing CS to his poke, and Ghost gives you the repositioning Mundo otherwise lacks to dodge Q or stay outside his level-6 E engage range.

playing.title: Hug minions to block Q
playing.detail: Corrosive Charge (800 range, 10-8s cooldown) is a location skillshot; stand behind your caster minions so it has to clear them first, forcing him to waste the cooldown on your wave instead of you.

playing.title: Trade only after his W fires
playing.detail: Purge slows Urgot while he unloads and starts at a 12s cooldown; once he's used it, step in with Q (Infected Cleaver, 4s cooldown, max-health damage) while he's locked down and recovering.

playing.title: Respect the level 6 Disdain-execute combo
playing.detail: From level 6, a landed E (Disdain, 475 range) throws you out of position and sets up R (Fear Beyond Death) for the kill. Don't stand near walls or jungle entrances where the throw would be worse.

playing.title: Spike E (Masochism) off low health
playing.detail: Masochism's AD scales with your missing health, so your hardest trades come when you're already hurt, not at full HP — commit to fights off that spike instead of before it.

playing.title: Only toggle W in his face
playing.detail: Burning Agony is a 325-range AoE drain centered on you; it does nothing from range, so only run it during extended melee trades once you're already in contact.

playing.title: Farm through the harass
playing.detail: Matches OP.GG's own read on the matchup — don't contest poke trades, just hold CS with Doran's Shield sustain and let the item-timer race play out.

playing.title: Force fights after your core spikes
playing.detail: The 57.1%-winning Warmog's into Heartsteel into Titanic Hydra path is your power spike; look for skirmishes once that core is up rather than forcing anything earlier.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win rates are measured from real games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own read on how those numbers play out.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Urgot’s (Q). Manage your distance well as Urgot will use (E) - (R) after reaching level 6 to kill you. Focus on farming lane!
